provenance.zh: 文档/词组标签依据图片转录，可能存在拼写估读误差；带状位置与 10 组箱线图五数概括为视觉估计。300 条文档—词组关联流线由固定种子 202622 模拟，不是从图片恢复的真实关联权重或文本分析结果。蓝色小方点是路径控制位置的视觉标记，不表示额外观测。
provenance.en: Document/topic labels are transcribed with possible reading errors; band positions and ten box summaries are visual estimates. The 300 association curves are simulated with seed 202622, not recovered links or text-analysis results. Blue squares mark path-routing positions and are not additional observations.

zh: 文档或文档组的 ID 和短标签；主题、关键词或词组的 ID、标签与类别颜色。
文档—词组关联表：如共现次数、TF-IDF、主题权重或人工编码强度；必须说明自己的权重含义。
可选：每个词组的某项数值指标分布，或同一指标的有序五数概括。Dissemination 在原图中的定义未核实，可替换为自己有定义的覆盖率或其他指标。
en: Document/document-group IDs and short labels; topic, keyword or word-group IDs, labels and colors.
Document-to-topic association rows, such as co-occurrence counts, TF-IDF, topic weights or coded strengths, with a documented definition.
Optionally, a defined per-topic metric distribution or ordered five-number summary. The source meaning of Dissemination is unverified; replace it with a defined coverage or other metric.

preprocessing.zh: 预先整理关联表与词组表；把每条流线的起止位置写成所属带内的 0–1 布局比例。颜色取目标词组，线宽=weight×flow_width，弯曲路径通过组内中心聚束。路径不是时间顺序，也不是守恒 Sankey 流量。箱线图读取给定摘要，不从流线权重推导。
preprocessing.en: Prepare association and label tables upstream. Give each link start/end a 0–1 layout fraction within its band. Color follows the target topic, width equals weight×flow_width, and paths bundle through group centers. Curves are neither chronology nor conserved Sankey flows. Boxes use supplied summaries, not quantities inferred from link weights.

description.zh: 正值关联权重；乘以 flow_width 得到线宽
description.en: Positive association weight; multiplied by flow_width for line width

description.zh: 流线起点在文档带内的位置；布局参数
description.en: Link start position within document band; layout parameter

description.zh: 流线终点在词组带内的位置；布局参数
description.en: Link end position within topic band; layout parameter
